div.head: VI Atr 8
div.ab: K. ⁊ witena gerædnes is, þæt man rihte laga up arære for Gode ⁊ for worolde ⁊ æghwilce unlaga georne afylle,
⁊ witena gerædnes is, þæt man rihte laga up arære for Gode ⁊ for worolde ⁊ æghwilce unlaga georne afylle;
And witena gerædnes is þæt man rihte laga up arære for Gode and for worolde and æghwilce unlaga georne afylle.
Und Verordnung der Witan ist, dass man echte Rechtsordnungen aufrichte im Kirchlichen und im Weltlichen und jeden Rechtsmissbrauch eifrig abschaffe,
And it is the ordinance of the witan that just laws be set up in spiritual and in secular matters, and every abuse of law be eagerly suppressed,
And the decree of the councillors is, that justice shall be promoted in matters both religious and secular, and all injustice zealously suppressed;
And the decree of the councilors is that just laws shall be upheld before God and the world, and all that is unlawful zealously renounced.
